description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the land in Moragaswewa, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120101
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details (both state-owned and private), and legal status. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land adjudication and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
